description: This is a test source file for the RawMessageMapper class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing the mapping of messages to external messages and vice versa.

classes.name: RawMessageMapperTest
classes.description: A unit test class for the RawMessageMapper, testing various mapping scenarios between internal message representations and external messages.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a new instance of RawMessageMapper before each test.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithoutPayloadWithoutContentType
methods.description: Tests mapping an internal message without payload or content type to an external message.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithTextPayload
methods.description: Tests mapping an internal message with a text payload to an external message.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithBinaryPayload
methods.description: Tests mapping an internal message with a binary payload to an external message.

methods.name: mapFromJsonMessageWithBinaryContentType
methods.description: Tests that mapping a JSON message with application/octet-stream content type throws MessageFormatInvalidException.

methods.name: mapFromTextMessageWithBinaryContentType
methods.description: Tests that mapping a text message with application/octet-stream content type throws MessageFormatInvalidException.

methods.name: mapFromNonMessageCommand
methods.description: Tests mapping a non-message command instance, expecting it to be mapped via a different mapper.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithDittoProtocolContentType
methods.description: Tests mapping a message with a Ditto protocol content type to the default behavior (expected to match a standard map).

methods.name: mapToMessageWithoutHeadersOrConfig
methods.description: Tests that mapping an external message without headers or configuration throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: mapToMessageWithoutThingId
methods.description: Tests that mapping an external message missing a thing ID header throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: mapToBinaryMessagePerDefault
methods.description: Tests mapping an external message with binary payload to an internal signal, verifying payload encoding.

methods.name: mapToTextMessage
methods.description: Tests mapping an external text message to an internal SendThingMessage.

methods.name: mapToTextMessageWithContentTypeOverride
methods.description: Tests overriding the content type to 'text/plain' and mapping accordingly.

methods.name: mapToBinaryMessageWithContentTypeOverride
methods.description: Tests overriding the content type and mapping a text message to binary payload.

methods.name: mapToJsonMessage
methods.description: Tests mapping a JSON string to an internal message with JSON payload.

methods.name: mapToDittoProtocolMessage
methods.description: Tests mapping to a message with a Ditto protocol content type, expecting a specific response type.

methods.name: mapToSendFeatureMessageResponse
methods.description: Tests mapping headers indicating a feature message response to the corresponding internal signal.

methods.name: mapToNonMessageCommandWithDittoProtocolContentType
methods.description: Tests mapping a non-message command with Ditto protocol content type, expecting proper mapping back.

methods.name: messageBuilder
methods.description: Helper method to create a MessageBuilder with optional content type.
